title: Understanding Histograms
text: A histogram is useful for visualizing the distribution of a single numerical variable. It shows how often each range of values occurs in the dataset.

title: Choosing the Right Plot
text: Consider what type of data you have. If you want to see the frequency of different ranges of a numerical variable, a histogram might be appropriate.
